input.quote: Customer will not assign this Agreement or any of its rights hereunder without the prior written consent of IBM, such consent not to be unreasonably withheld. Notwithstanding the foregoing, Customer may assign this Agreement to a successor organization by merger, consolidation or acquisition.
input.rationale: § 14.10 binds only Customer: we need IBM's consent for assignments (with an M&A successor carve-out), while IBM's own right to assign is entirely unrestricted (and § 14.18 expressly contemplates "assignees of IBM Corp."). That fails the fallback, which requires a mutual right to assign to successors with a not-unreasonably-withheld consent standard for other assignments, because there is no consent gate or competitor bar on IBM's side. There is no change-of-control termination or re-pricing right anywhere in the Agreement, so no walk-away trigger. The redline restores mutuality by requiring our consent (not unreasonably withheld) for IBM assignments and barring assignment to our competitors, and adds the affiliate/asset-sale carve-out on our side to reach the preferred position; the reciprocal consent language alone would be an acceptable fallback.

ops.oldText: Notwithstanding the foregoing, Customer may assign this Agreement to a successor organization by merger, consolidation or acquisition.
ops.newText: Notwithstanding the foregoing, Customer may assign this Agreement, without IBM's consent, to an Affiliate or to a successor organization by merger, consolidation, acquisition or sale of substantially all of its assets. IBM will not assign this Agreement or any of its rights hereunder without Customer's prior written consent, such consent not to be unreasonably withheld, and in no event to a competitor of Customer.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have made the assignment provision reciprocal: IBM's assignment now requires our consent (not unreasonably withheld) and cannot be to our competitor, and we have added the standard affiliate/asset-sale carve-out to our side. Our playbook requires at least mutual assignment rights, and as drafted only we were restricted.
proposal.summary: Make § 14.10 mutual: add affiliate/asset-sale carve-out for Customer and a consent requirement on IBM assignment.
